aṯyono, sәmli qәṣd di+Ndaṯalo,  i+emo dәMšiḥoyo, sәmli… ádyawma, dәmṣalyono bgawa — oballa nahire, mṣalina bgawa— aṯyono qәm raġla di+Ndaṯalo, hawxa. 
haṯe i+Ndaṯalo ḥaqiqi haṯeyo, i+Maryamane i+emo dәMšiḥo, haṯeyo.
Aʕ+ʕeḏe di+ʕito áydarbo kowən? 
Áydarbo, aʕ+ʕeḏe di+ʕito? 
aʕ+ʕeḏe diʕito kosaymínanne disa ʕeḏe ... ʕeḏo naʕimo lazǝmyo. 
u+ʕeḏano, ʕeḏo zʕuro, u+mawlodo dәMšiḥoyo. 
ŭ nuḥrina ṣafure, saymina i+k̇ŭrbune  dәMšiḥo, ŭ gǝdnuḥrínanne, ŭ g̊saymina marga ŭ rezo, ŭ gdobina sәkkar šakar lan+noše ayna doṯe. 
koṯe mašәlmone maq+qәryawoṯani diḏan kulle.

kobinale šakar, kobinanne medone. 
u+ʕeḏano meqәm lo+ḥayfíwayna hul ḥamšaḥṣar+yawme, lo+maḥtíwayna maye ʕal qarʕan, hul lu+yawmo dmaʕmaḏ  Mšiḥo, u+yawmo dmaʕmaḏ Mšiḥo. 
henú gmaʕmḏina, kḥayfina, maḥtíwayna maye ǧamude ʕal qarʕayna, bu+šәkl di+murәn.
ono bŭxwá he hawxa kosaymono, lo+aǧ+ǧulayḏi lo+ad+dәsmalayḏi, ŭ lo+ḥәfli, mu+ʕeḏo hul lalye du+danḥo. 
lalye du+danḥo әmmono, ‘ya rab xud dәslәglux  u+mohr dAdam bәMšiḥo, dhat sәlgat aḥ+ḥṭohayḏan’, – ḥәfli ŭ qayimono falge+dlalyo i+saʕa ba+traḥṣar, ḥәfli ŭ maḥatli maye ǧamude ʕal i+lašayḏi, ŭ lwәšli aǧ+ǧulayḏi, hawxa.
Ŭ ha ádlalyoste i+Ndaṯaloyo, disa aṯina, sǝmli qәṣd dAloho.

ŭ gdoṯәn disane ag+gundi, aq+qariwe, raḥuqe, ṭaye, gdoṯәn gdobinanne tarte+tarte, tlaṯ+tlaṯ, arbaʕ+arbaʕ ḥammәš, hawo ʕeḏo di+fṣiḥuṯoyo, dəMšiḥo.

aḥna glawšina maǧ+ǧule maqalbe yani ḥәznina dә Mšiḥo, dlaǧ+ǧuhu ṣluwe.

daḥnastene bu+šәklayḏe kosaymina, hē aḥna i+modayḏan tarke, hē lə+mdagšilan, hē lə+mdagšilan. 
hawxa.
Kibi mšālnax kmo+šuwole, əšmax, ŭ əšma di+ʕaylayḏax mǝnyo?
I+ʕaylayḏi, əšmi buxwá, əšmi Nisáneyo. 
ʕUmrax mə́qqayo?
ʕUmri, arbaʕ+ŭ+tmoni.
Ayko hawat?
B Bequsyone hawyono, ŭ mḥawlono l Derqube, i+kalo dad+Derqubìyeno.
Ayko koʕayšat aġlab? 
Harke? 
Lo! 
Koʕayšono b Derqube, ádyawma ʕam an+naʕime aṯyono, haṯe i+barṯàyḏiyo, hano u+ḥaṯnàyḏiyo, aṯən lu+ʕeḏayḏan lriša di+šato, aṯyono aʕmayye, səmli qəṣd d Aloho ŭ di+Ndaṯalo ádlalyo. 
Haṯe i+Ndaṯàloyo, gəmṣalina bgawa, gdoṯe u+qašo me Bequsyone, gmoḥe lu+noqušo, gdoṯina mṣalina ádlalyo bgawa, ŭ ṣafro bgawa, edi ya hənnək gəmblili, ya gdoṯe u+zʕurayḏi mbeli, hawxa.
Azzáx li+madrăse di+ʕito?
La‿ʔašə́r lazzí, madrăse ínaqqayo latwa, maketəb latwa, latwa ínaqqayo, elo koṯən  aq+qaše, koṯən aq+qaše koqorən təšʕiṯo, qorən at+tešʕəyawoṯe daq+qadiše, e, komarfono aḏni aʕlayye, ko..., yani, kohnanne, kofǝhmono mənne. 
Babax ŭ emax manne?
Babi Barṣáwmowa. 
Emi, ono ḥamməš+šnaye, emi mḥasyo. 
Lqašti tlélali ŭ maḥátlali, moráwlalan, tarte+k̇ačk̇at ŭ arbʕo+abne. 
Abro mdiḏa, aḥuni, tloṯo+yarḥe, emi mḥasyo. 
Ḥoṯi makǝrxówayle ʕal aṗ+ṗirat, meqǝm ḥalwo ŭ mamməkat medone latwa, mamṣə́nwanne me ṣadrayye. 
Makraxla ʕal aṗ+ṗirat, sǝmla . 
. . səmle tarte+šnaye, māṯ bi+ḥazbe, kewo, kətwa ḥazbe, daqqat semoqe howewa bi+laše du+ənsā̀n. 
Taxetǝr latwa, māṯ eba.
Ŭ a+tloṯo+aḥunone ŭ ono ŭ ḥoṯi. 
Ḥoṯi kamə́ltowa, ŭ ono ʕəmri ḥamməš+šnàyewa, ŭ babi fayəš hul hani kibe, he laybe, arbʕi+šnaye. 
Hăma, me ʕəmre d ʕAbdǝl+Masī̀ḥ bábiste mḥase. 
Aḥúniste hani arbaʕ̥+ḥamməš+šnaye mḥase, Muqsi Šamʕən, ŭ kətli he tre+aḥunone sāġ, ŭ ono. 
Ha kanné hanək b Bárčiqa, lanne harke aḥunoni.
Kətli ḥḏaḥsar+naʕime, ḥamməš+k̇ačk̇at ŭ əšto+abne. 
Əšmayye, əšme du+rabo Abrohom, ŭ dnaʕəm Musa, ŭ dnaʕəmṫə́r Gabriyel, ŭ dnaʕəmṫə́r Bənyamen, ŭ dnaʕəmṫə́r ʕAbdǝl+Masī̀ḥ, ŭ u+naʕimo Əndrawos. 
I+k̇ačk̇e i+rabṯo Sayde, ŭ dnaʕəm Səṫṫo, ŭ dnaʕəm Maǧida, ŭ dnaʕəm Gule, ŭ haṯe Ḥana, hawxa.
Ayna lišone məǧġəlwa babax?
Lešono suryoyo xoṯi, suryoyo məǧġalwa. 
Kurdóyoste məǧġolina bayn ḥḏóḏena, kurdóyoste koḏaʕwa, elo ṣuroyo məǧġolíwayna aḥna. 
Aḥna ŭ ak+kuldoye kalán bayn ḥḏoḏe ǧiránena. 
Aq+qəryawoṯo d̥ḥeḏoran kulle kuldóyene, yalifina koməǧġolina b̥kuldóyoste.
Əšme dǧəddax mənwa?
Lo+babi? 
Ǧəddi Gawríyewa, u+babo dǧəddi Úsowa.
Ayko hawi?
B Bequsyone.
Mənyo əšma d̥qaštax? 
Qašti Máryamwa. 
emi Xázmewa, emi Xázmewa, qašti Máryamwa.
Me Bequsyónene?
Me Bequsyone, Bequsyone.
Kəmmi maḥkí i+ǧuwanitiyayḏax, i+ʕlaymuṯayḏax.
I+ʕlaymuṯayḏi, i+ǧuwanitiyayḏi?
Qaruto, bu+waxtawo mə‿kətwa? 
Dəmmina, me ḥeḏorayxu an+noše mə‿saymiwa, áydarbo howewa?
E ma mə‿kəmmanne? 
Dawríwayna, ŭ ḥusdíwayna, ŭ săwā́l kə́twaylan, ʕayšíwayna ʕal u+săwā̀l, əzzáwayna marʕíwayna aʕ+ʕeze, aq+qanyone, ʕasriye ḥulwíwaynanne, maḥtíwayna bu+gawdo, hawxa mayʕíwayna, makina latwa, mayʕíwayna hawxa. 
Əmmíwayna: 
kəlmašk̇e dbe baqoro,  
nafəq məšḥo xud̥‿qatoro, 
hawxa mayʕíwayna.
A+bnoṯo ema məṭlobiwa? 
Bakmo+əšne bu+waxtaṯxu?
A+bnoṯe! 
Aḥna kə́twaylan šuġlo, ṭaʕnan yaqúrowa. 
Ṭrallan ʕəsri+ʕəsri, tarte+ŭ ʕəsri+šnaye, hawxa, ṭoríwaynanne, yani, šuġlíwaylan šanan. 
U+babaṯṯe čik̇e nafás darləġí kətwa aʕle, xud u+kayìwowa. 
Ánnaqqa an+naʕìmeste əzzənwa lu+maktab, edi mašəġlíwayna bak̇+k̇ačk̇at ha ha Ḥana.
Kuḏʕat zmaryoṯe ḥrene? 
Zmaryoṯe? 
Lo+məfqatli ba+zmaryoṯe, me Almanya kəmdaʕən aʕli bi+hăvale! 
Lo, lo, hayo lo+maḥtatla bi+ḥolo!
Bele bele qay? 
Dəḏʕat, mar kmo+xabre karye.
Lo+kudʕono, ʕáyboyo. 
Na na na ʕáyboya!
 Ínaqqa dəmḥawalle i+kalo du+abrayḏi u+rabo, d Abrohom, ṭləbbe zmarto mini, i+hăvale, mḥalle ... ŭ mbaṭalle u+müzìk tamo bu+ṣalòn, ŭ mḥalle u+hnawo hawxa qəm femayye, əmmi, ‘Ánnaqqa mar!’
Əmmono,    
Yade, Marqus henu, raṣṭa! 
Yade, qurbān, henu, raṣṭa!
barxə́ki šərkərí, maṣṭa, 
ya go ṫa dvibu diya ṫa  
ŭ bave ṫa ž̥tara guhastən. 
Lilililili,
Čuma xana, dreda hăvale, 
Az hatəma xana, dəreda hăvā́l dălale,
Čəl zavak̇i ṫeda, hăvale, 
Čəl zavak̇i ṫeda hăvā́l dalale! 
Zavak̇ē ma l ḥamū wa zēda,  
Zavak̇ē ma l ḥamū wa zēda.
Kətwa zmaryoṯe suryoye?
E, e, zəmriwa, ínaqqayo kəmmono xud u+k̇urmanǧiwa.
Bu+suryoyo lo+zəmriwa?
Lo, i+zmarṭo ʕal u+k̇urmanǧiwa. 
Lo+fāš mede? 
Ġálawa, məblíwayna an+nabišoṯe... An+nabišoṯe, kuḏʕat mənne? 
Nabišoṯe – layto? 
Nabišoṯe ʕə́nwene, komaḥtínanne bu+qayṭo, koġayṭínanne bad+darmone, maḥtina bi+šəmšo, kowə‿nabisoṯe. 
Məblíwaynanne lə Sʕert, hul dəmzabníwaynanne. 
Qayṣíwayna u+marʕeze daʕ+ʕeze, u+saʕro daʕ+ʕeze, qayṣíwaynale, əmblíwaynale lə Sʕert, mzabníwaynale.
Ínaqqayo ba+ḥmore, baḥ+ḥayewən əzzáwayna, ʕárabat latwa, baʕ+ʕarabat zanwa. 
U+dibəs, əmblíwaynale lə Gziro, háwoste, koʕuṣrile hawxa, dayši aʕlayye, ʕuṣrənne aʕ+ʕənwe, ʕuṣrənne, ŭ k̬maḥtínanne bab+baredəš, mbašlínanne, ŭ maḥtina darmone baynaṯte, mbašlínanne, qayšina i+kafaṯṯe, bəšli bəšli bəšli bəšli, hul d̥owe qašyo, d̥owe hawxa. 
Maʕlina i+mqašiye, d̥owe ṭarfo, edi‿ak̇a g̊d̥owe ṭarfo, gmanaḥtínale. 
Dibəs, háwoste əmblíwaynale lə Gziro mzabníwaynale.
Harke kosaymina qawite, muqḏina bi+ṣaymənto Xədəlyás, muqḏina aḥ+ḥeṭe bu+dawqo, mqalínanne, ŭ gursínanne, ŭ matrínanne bam+maye ḥalye, bəṯr maḥtina dibəs aʕlayye, layšinanne, saymina i+qawite di+Xədəlyase, kəmmina aḥna u+ṣawmo d Nənwe, u+ṣawmo d Nənwe, hənna harke... kəmmina i+Xədəlyase.

Don’t expose me with songs, from Germany they are demanding Hevala from me.

sentences.translation: No, no, don’t put it into play (lit. ‘on the floor’)!

sentences.translation: When they were transporting the daughter-in-law of my elder son, Abrohom, they demanded the Hevala from me, they put ... and they stopped the music there in the hall, and they put that whatsit (i.e., the microphone) like so in front of their mouths, they say, ‘Now then, say it!’

It was the Famine, we would take raisins ... Raisins, do you know what they are?

sentences.translation: Raisins – you know what (lit. ‘there isn’t’, i.e. in your knowledge)?

items.value: Raisins – you know what (lit. ‘there isn’t’, i.e. in your knowledge)?

sentences.source_line: Nabišoṯe ʕə́nwene, komaḥtínanne bu+qayṭo, koġayṭínanne bad+darmone, maḥtina bi+šəmšo, kowə‿nabisoṯe.
sentences.translation: Raisins are grapes, we put them out in summer, we dip them in chemicals, we put them out in the sun, they become raisins.

items.value: Nabišoṯe ʕə́nwene, komaḥtínanne bu+qayṭo, koġayṭínanne bad+darmone, maḥtina bi+šəmšo, kowə‿nabisoṯe.
Raisins are grapes, we put them out in summer, we dip them in chemicals, we put them out in the sun, they become raisins.

sentences.translation: We would take them to Siirt, until we would sell them out.

items.value: We would take them to Siirt, until we would sell them out.

sentences.source_line: Qayṣíwayna u+marʕeze daʕ+ʕeze, u+saʕro daʕ+ʕeze, qayṣíwaynale, əmblíwaynale lə Sʕert, mzabníwaynale.
sentences.translation: We would cut goat wool, goat hair, we would cut it, we would took it to Siirt, we would sell it.

items.value: Qayṣíwayna u+marʕeze daʕ+ʕeze, u+saʕro daʕ+ʕeze, qayṣíwaynale, əmblíwaynale lə Sʕert, mzabníwaynale.
We would cut goat wool, goat hair, we would cut it, we would took it to Siirt, we would sell it.

sentences.source_line: Ínaqqayo ba+ḥmore, baḥ+ḥayewən əzzáwayna, ʕárabat latwa, baʕ+ʕarabat zanwa.
sentences.translation: At that time we would go on donkeys, on animals, there weren’t any cars, we would(n’t) go by cars.

items.value: Ínaqqayo ba+ḥmore, baḥ+ḥayewən əzzáwayna, ʕárabat latwa, baʕ+ʕarabat zanwa.
At that time we would go on donkeys, on animals, there weren’t any cars, we would(n’t) go by cars.

sentences.source_line: U+dibəs, əmblíwaynale lə Gziro, háwoste, koʕuṣrile hawxa, dayši aʕlayye, ʕuṣrənne aʕ+ʕənwe, ʕuṣrənne, ŭ k̬maḥtínanne bab+baredəš, mbašlínanne, ŭ maḥtina darmone baynaṯte, mbašlínanne, qayšina i+kafaṯṯe, bəšli bəšli bəšli bəšli, hul d̥owe qašyo, d̥owe hawxa.
sentences.translation: The grape molasses, we would take it to Cizre, that one, they press it like so, they trample them, they press the grapes, they press them, and we put them in cooking pots, we cook them, and we put chemicals among them, we cook them, we skim off the foam, they boil, boil, boil, boil, until it becomes hard, it becomes like so.

items.value: U+dibəs, əmblíwaynale lə Gziro, háwoste, koʕuṣrile hawxa, dayši aʕlayye, ʕuṣrənne aʕ+ʕənwe, ʕuṣrənne, ŭ k̬maḥtínanne bab+baredəš, mbašlínanne, ŭ maḥtina darmone baynaṯte, mbašlínanne, qayšina i+kafaṯṯe, bəšli bəšli bəšli bəšli, hul d̥owe qašyo, d̥owe hawxa.

The grape molasses, we would take it to Cizre, that one, they press it like so, they trample them, they press the grapes, they press them, and we put them in cooking pots, we cook them, and we put chemicals among them, we cook them, we skim off the foam, they boil, boil, boil, boil, until it becomes hard, it becomes like so.

sentences.source_line: Maʕlina i+mqašiye, d̥owe ṭarfo, edi‿ak̇a g̊d̥owe ṭarfo, gmanaḥtínale.
sentences.translation: We lift the skimmer, when it becomes a leaf, then if it becomes a leaf, we take it down.

items.value: Maʕlina i+mqašiye, d̥owe ṭarfo, edi‿ak̇a g̊d̥owe ṭarfo, gmanaḥtínale.
We lift the skimmer, when it becomes a leaf, then if it becomes a leaf, we take it down.

sentences.source_line: Dibəs, háwoste əmblíwaynale lə Gziro mzabníwaynale.
sentences.translation: Grape syrup, that one too we would take to Cizre, we would sell it.

items.value: Dibəs, háwoste əmblíwaynale lə Gziro mzabníwaynale.

sentences.source_line: Harke kosaymina qawite, muqḏina bi+ṣaymənto Xədəlyás, muqḏina aḥ+ḥeṭe bu+dawqo, mqalínanne, ŭ gursínanne, ŭ matrínanne bam+maye ḥalye, bəṯr maḥtina dibəs aʕlayye, layšinanne, saymina i+qawite di+Xədəlyase, kəmmina aḥna u+ṣawmo d Nənwe, u+ṣawmo d Nənwe, hənna harke... kəmmina i+Xədəlyase.
sentences.translation: Here we make kavut, we burn it during the Hıdırellez fast, we burn wheat in a skillet, we roast them, and we grind them, and we moisten them with sweet water, then we put grape molasses on them, we knead them, we make Hıdırellez kavut, we call it the Fast of Nineveh, the Fast of Nineveh, some people here ... we call it Hıdırellez.

items.value: Harke kosaymina qawite, muqḏina bi+ṣaymənto Xədəlyás, muqḏina aḥ+ḥeṭe bu+dawqo, mqalínanne, ŭ gursínanne, ŭ matrínanne bam+maye ḥalye, bəṯr maḥtina dibəs aʕlayye, layšinanne, saymina i+qawite di+Xədəlyase, kəmmina aḥna u+ṣawmo d Nənwe, u+ṣawmo d Nənwe, hənna harke... kəmmina i+Xədəlyase.

Here we make kavut, we burn it during the Hıdırellez fast, we burn wheat in a skillet, we roast them, and we grind them, and we moisten them with sweet water, then we put grape molasses on them, we knead them, we make Hıdırellez kavut, we call it the Fast of Nineveh, the Fast of Nineveh, some people here ... we call it Hıdırellez.
